'''D-7RZ''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]] D-7RZ was on the [[Carrick Station]], where he relayed to an important figure a priority request from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to report to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vom Dresid]] on the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-7RZ appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Operation courier for the "Scum and Villainy" operation. Originally present on the Carrick Station, he was moved to [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] with Update 4.0.
